faqs.questionEn: How do I create an account?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Select **Sign In** at the top right, enter your email and select **Continue**.
2. If the email is not registered yet, the **Join for Free** page opens. Enter your **Full Name** (1 to 50 letters or numbers) and a **Password** of 8 to 72 characters, then tick the box to accept the **Terms of Use** and **Privacy Notice**.
3. Select **Join for Free**. If we send you an activation email, open the link within 24 hours, then sign in.

You can also use **Google** or **WeChat** under **Or continue with**.
faqs.questionZh: 如何注册账号？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 点击右上角的**登录**，输入邮箱后点击**继续**。
2. 如果该邮箱尚未注册，会打开**免费加入**页面。填写**姓名**（1 到 50 个文字或数字字符）和 8 到 72 个字符的**密码**，并勾选同意**使用条款**和**隐私声明**。
3. 点击**免费加入**。如果我们向你发送了激活邮件，请在 24 小时内打开链接，然后再登录。

你也可以在**或使用以下方式继续**下选择 **Google** 或**微信**。

faqs.questionEn: I already have an account, but when I enter my email the sign-up page opens. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
The sign-up page opens when the email you typed is not registered.
1. Check the address for typos. On the **Join for Free** page the **Email** box is read-only and shows what you typed.
2. Select **Sign in** next to "Already have an account?", enter your email again and select **Continue**.
3. If you signed up with **Google** or **WeChat**, select that button under **Or continue with** instead of typing an email.
4. If the address is correct and you still cannot sign in, select **Learning Guide** at the top left to go to the home page, then select **Contact us** in the **Support** section at the bottom.

faqs.questionEn: Sign-up says my name or password is not valid. What are the rules?
faqs.answerEn:
1. **Full Name**: enter 1 to 50 letters or numbers. You can use spaces, hyphens (-), apostrophes (') and middle dots (·). Other symbols such as $ are not accepted.
2. **Password**: enter between 8 and 72 characters. The hint says "Between 8 and 72 characters".
3. Select **Join for Free** again.
faqs.questionZh: 注册时提示姓名或密码不符合要求，规则是什么？

1. **姓名**：输入 1 到 50 个文字或数字字符。可以使用空格、连字符 (-)、撇号 (') 和间隔号 (·)，不接受 $ 等其他符号。
2. **密码**：长度为 8 到 72 个字符（页面提示“长度为 8 到 72 个字符”）。
3. 再次点击**免费加入**。

faqs.questionEn: I tried to create an account, but it says my email is already registered. What now?
faqs.answerEn:
1. "This email is already registered and activated." means an account already exists for that address. You do not need another one.
2. After a few seconds the page moves to **Sign in** with your email filled in. Enter your password and select **Sign in**.
3. If you have forgotten the password, select **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page.

faqs.questionEn: The sign-in page says my email address is not valid. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The page shows "Enter a valid email address. After an underscore (_), use a letter or number." Enter the address in the form name@example.com.
2. Before the @, use only letters, numbers and the separators . _ - and follow each separator with a letter or number. For example, faq_user@example.com works, but faq_@example.com does not. Characters such as + are not accepted.
3. Select **Continue** again.

2. @ 前面只能使用字母、数字以及 . _ - 这几个分隔符，且每个分隔符后面必须紧跟字母或数字。例如 faq_user@example.com 可以，faq_@example.com 不行。不接受 + 等其他字符。
3. 再次点击**继续**。

faqs.questionEn: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
faqs.answerEn:
1. On the sign-in page, enter your email and select **Continue**, then select **Forgot password?**.
2. Check that the **Email** is the one you signed up with, then select **Send reset email**.
3. Open the reset link in the email within one hour. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.
4. Enter the new **Password** and **Confirm new password**, then select **Reset password**.

2. 确认**邮箱**是注册时使用的邮箱，然后点击**发送重置邮件**。
3. 请在一小时内打开邮件中的重置链接。如果没有看到邮件，请检查垃圾邮件文件夹。
4. 输入新的**密码**和**确认新密码**，然后点击**重置密码**。

faqs.questionEn: I did not get the password reset email. What can I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Check your inbox and your spam or junk folder. The reset link expires in one hour.
2. Check the address shown on the **Check your email** page. A reset email is only sent if that address belongs to an account. To try another address, select **Use another email**.
3. When the "Please wait 60s before sending again." countdown ends, select **Resend reset email**.
4. If it still does not arrive, select **Learning Guide** at the top left to go to the home page, then select **Contact us** in the **Support** section at the bottom.

faqs.questionEn: How do I change my password?
faqs.answerEn:
There is no password field in **Personal settings**. To set a new password, use a reset email.
1. Select your avatar at the top right and select **Sign out**.
2. On the sign-in page, enter your email, select **Continue**, then select **Forgot password?** and **Send reset email**.
3. Open the link in the email within one hour (check your spam folder), enter your new password in **Password** and **Confirm new password** (8 to 72 characters) and select **Reset password**.

3. 在一小时内打开邮件中的链接（请检查垃圾邮件文件夹），在**密码**和**确认新密码**中输入新密码（8 到 72 个字符），然后点击**重置密码**。

faqs.questionEn: I did not get the activation email, or the activation link has expired.
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: Can I sign in with Google?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. On the sign-in page, select **Google** under **Or continue with** and choose your Google account.

If your email is already registered with a password, you may see "An account already uses this email. Sign in with your email and password before linking Google." In that case:
1. Sign in with your email and password.
2. Select your avatar at the top right and open **Personal settings**.
3. Under **Sign-in methods**, select **Connect Google**. Once connected, it shows "You can sign in with Google at any time."

faqs.questionEn: Why do I need to add an email when I sign in with WeChat?
faqs.answerEn:
The first time you sign in with WeChat, you bind an email address to finish setting up your account so you can continue learning or purchasing. This step cannot be skipped; the only other option on the page is **Sign out**.
1. Enter your email and select **Send verification email**.
2. Open the binding link in that email within 24 hours. You can resend after 60 seconds.
3. If it says the email is already used by another account, use a different email or sign in to that account instead.

1. 输入邮箱后点击**发送验证邮件**。
2. 在 24 小时内打开邮件里的绑定链接。两次发送之间需要等待 60 秒。
3. 如果提示该邮箱已被其他账号使用，请换一个邮箱，或直接登录那个账号。

faqs.questionEn: How do I change my name or personal details?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Select your avatar at the top right and select **Personal settings**.
2. Edit **Name** (1 to 50 letters or numbers; spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and middle dots are allowed).
3. Under **Personal details**, **Country** is required. **Age**, **Education** and **Areas of interest** (up to five) are optional.
4. Select **Save changes**. You should see "Settings saved."

You cannot upload a profile picture at the moment.
faqs.questionZh: 如何修改姓名或个人信息？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 点击右上角的头像，选择**个人设置**。
2. 修改**姓名**（1 到 50 个文字或数字字符，可使用空格、连字符、撇号和间隔号）。
3. 在**个人信息**中，**国家/地区**为必填项；**年龄**、**教育程度**和**感兴趣的领域**（最多 5 项）为选填项。
4. 点击**保存修改**，页面会显示“设置已保存。”

目前无法上传头像图片。

faqs.questionEn: My Personal settings will not save. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
1. **Name** must be 1 to 50 letters or numbers. Spaces, hyphens (-), apostrophes (') and middle dots (·) are allowed; other symbols are not.
2. **Country** is required. If you see "Country is required.", choose your country in the **Country** list under **Personal details**.
3. Select **Save changes** again. If you see "Settings update failed.", sign in again if you were signed out, then try once more.
4. If it still fails, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

faqs.questionEn: How do I stay signed in on my own computer?
faqs.answerEn:
1. On the sign-in page, tick **Keep me signed in** before you select **Sign in**.
2. With the box ticked, you stay signed in for about 14 days in this browser.
3. On a shared computer, leave the box unticked. When you finish, select your avatar at the top right and then **Sign out**.

2. 勾选后，此浏览器会保持登录约 14 天。
3. 在公用电脑上请不要勾选。使用完毕后，点击右上角的头像，选择**退出登录**。

faqs.questionEn: Why am I asked to sign in when I want to contact support?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Enquiries are linked to your account, so you need to be signed in to send one or to see **My enquiries**.
2. If you are signed out and select **Contact Support** on the help page (**Help Center / FAQ**), you are taken to sign in first and then returned to the enquiry form.
3. If you see "Your session has ended. Please sign in again.", sign in again and open **Contact Support** again.
4. If you cannot sign in at all, select **Contact us** in the **Support** section at the bottom of the home page.
faqs.questionZh: 为什么联系客服时要求我先登录？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 工单与你的账户绑定，因此需要登录后才能提交问题或查看**我的工单**。
2. 如果你未登录，在帮助页（**帮助中心 / 常见问题**）点击**联系客服**，会先跳转到登录页面，登录后返回问题表单。
3. 如果提示“登录已失效，请重新登录。”，请重新登录后再次打开**联系客服**。
4. 如果完全无法登录，请在首页底部的**支持**区域点击**联系我们**。

faqs.questionEn: The site is not loading or videos will not play. What can I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Refresh the page and sign in again if asked.
2. Try another up-to-date browser, or turn off browser extensions that block scripts or media.
3. Check your internet connection, then reopen the lesson.
4. If it still does not work, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, describe what you see (a screenshot helps) and select **Submit Enquiry**.

3. 检查网络连接后重新打开课时。
4. 仍无法使用时，请点击右上角头像，打开**我的学习**，在左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**），在**问题类型**中选择**技术支持**，描述你看到的情况（可附截图）后点击**提交问题**。

faqs.questionEn: My microphone or camera does not work in a Live Session.
faqs.answerEn:
1. Allow the microphone and camera in your browser's site settings (usually the icon beside the address bar), then try again.
2. If it is still blocked, allow your browser to use the camera and microphone in your device's privacy settings.
3. Close other apps that might be using the camera or microphone.
4. If you cannot hear anyone, select the notice "Sound is blocked by your browser. Click to turn it on."
faqs.questionZh: 直播课里麦克风或摄像头用不了怎么办？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 在浏览器的网站设置中允许本站使用麦克风和摄像头（通常在地址栏旁的图标里），然后重试。
2. 如果仍被阻止，请在设备的隐私设置中允许浏览器使用摄像头和麦克风。
3. 关闭可能正在占用摄像头或麦克风的其他应用。
4. 如果听不到声音，请点击页面上开启声音的提示，有些浏览器在你点击前会拦截声音。

faqs.questionEn: How can I access my course materials?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Select your avatar at the top right and choose **My Learning**.
2. On the course card, select **Resume Learning** to open your lessons. The button reads **Review Course** once the course is complete.
3. If a course is missing, open it from **Courses** and select **Start learning**. My Learning lists only courses you have started.

faqs.questionEn: I subscribed, but My Learning says I have not started any courses. Where is my course?
faqs.answerEn:
My Learning lists only courses you have started, so a new subscription or trial does not add a course card until you open a lesson.
1. Open **Courses** and select the course. It should show **Included in your plan** and **Start learning**.
2. Select **Start learning**. If you see **How would you like to learn?**, choose **Video Mode** or **Text Mode**, then select **Continue with Video** or **Continue with Text**.
3. Open **My Learning** from your avatar menu. The course card now appears with **Resume Learning**.

If the course page shows **View all benefits** instead of **Start learning**, your plan does not include this course.

1. 打开**课程**，选择该课程。课程页应显示**已包含在你的方案中**和**开始学习**。
2. 点击**开始学习**。如果出现“你希望如何学习？”，选择**视频模式**或**文本模式**，再点击**以视频模式继续**或**以文本模式继续**。
3. 从头像菜单打开**我的学习**，课程卡片就会出现，并带有**继续学习**按钮。

如果课程页显示的是**查看所有权益**而不是**开始学习**，说明你当前的方案不包含这门课程。

faqs.questionEn: How do I continue a course and keep my progress?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **My Learning** from your avatar menu. Each course card shows your current lesson (for example **Current: Lesson 1**), your learning mode and your progress.
2. Select **Resume Learning** to go back to that lesson. The button reads **Review Course** once the course is complete.
3. In a text lesson, select **Next lesson** at the end to complete the lesson and move on.
faqs.questionZh: 如何继续学习课程并保留进度？

2. 点击**继续学习**回到该课时。课程学完后，按钮会变为**回顾课程**。
3. 文本课时读完后，点击底部的**下一课时**完成本课时并继续。

faqs.questionEn: Can I try a course before I subscribe?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes, where a course offers a free preview or a trial. You need to be signed in first; if you are not, you are taken to the **Sign in or create account** page.
1. **Preview**: open **Courses**, select the course and select **Preview** next to the lesson that offers it. The preview shows part of the lesson.
2. **Trial**: some courses offer a three-day trial. On the course page select **View all benefits**. If a **Choose a plan** section appears, choose a plan and select **Start three-day trial**.

faqs.questionEn: My free preview says it has ended. How do I keep going?
faqs.answerEn:
A free preview shows only part of a lesson. To keep going you need a plan that includes the course.
1. In the preview, select **Choose access plan**. A window titled **Enjoying the course so far?** opens.
2. Select **Choose access plan** in that window, pick a plan that includes the course and complete checkout. On a course's own plan panel you may also see **Start three-day trial**.
3. When your access is active, go back to the course page and select **Start learning**.

faqs.answerZh:
免费试看只显示课时的一部分。要继续学习，需要订阅包含该课程的方案。
1. 在试看页面点击**选择访问方案**，会打开标题为“喜欢这门课程吗？”的窗口。
2. 点击窗口中的**选择访问方案**，选择包含该课程的方案并完成付款。课程自己的方案区域可能还会显示**开始三天试用**。
3. 访问权限生效后，回到课程页，点击**开始学习**。

faqs.questionEn: My course page has no Start learning button. How do I get the full course?
faqs.answerEn:
The course page shows **Start learning** only when your plan includes the course. Otherwise it shows **Preview** on a lesson that offers one, a price under **INCLUDED WITH A CATEGORY PLAN**, and a **View all benefits** link.
1. To try the course first, select **Preview** next to the lesson.
2. For full access, select **View all benefits**, choose a plan that includes the course and complete checkout.
3. When your access is active, go back to the course page and select **Start learning**.

faqs.questionEn: I click a lesson and I am sent back to the course page. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
Lessons open only while you have access to the course. If your trial was cancelled or your subscription has ended, the lesson link takes you back to the course page.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and check **Current subscriptions**. Plans that have ended are under **Past subscriptions**.
2. On **My Learning**, a course card showing **View plans** means you no longer have access. Select **View plans** and choose a plan that includes the course.
3. If your subscription is current and the lesson still sends you back, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

1. 打开**我的学习** > **我的订阅**，查看**当前订阅**。已结束的订阅显示在**历史订阅**中。
2. 在**我的学习**中，如果课程卡片显示**查看订阅方案**，说明你已没有访问权限。点击**查看订阅方案**，选择包含该课程的方案。
3. 如果订阅仍然有效但课时仍然跳转，请点击右上角头像，打开**我的学习**，在左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**）。

faqs.questionEn: Can I read lessons instead of watching videos?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes, in courses that offer both a video and a text version.
1. The first time you start such a course, choose **Video Mode** or **Text Mode** in **How would you like to learn?**, then select **Continue with Video** or **Continue with Text**.
2. To switch later, open a lesson and use the **Video mode** / **Text mode** drop-down under the course title.

Text-only courses show a fixed **Text mode** label instead.

2. 之后想切换，请打开课时，使用课程标题下方的**视频模式** / **文本模式**下拉菜单。

只有文本的课程会固定显示**文本模式**标签。

faqs.questionEn: Why is there only text and no video in my lesson?
faqs.answerEn:
Not every course has both formats.
1. On the lesson page, look under the course title. A drop-down labelled **Video mode** or **Text mode** means the course offers both, and you can switch with it.
2. A plain **Text mode** label with no arrow means the course has text only.
3. If you expected a video and cannot switch to **Video mode**, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

2. 只显示**文本模式**且没有箭头，表示该课程只有文本。

faqs.questionEn: How do I finish a text lesson and move on to the next one?
faqs.answerEn:
In Text Mode, the **Next lesson** button at the bottom of the lesson completes it.
1. Read the lesson to the end and select **Next lesson**.
2. A window such as **Lesson 1 completed** opens. If tests are available, you can select **Knowledge Test** or **Application Test**.
3. Select **Next lesson** in the window to continue.

1. 读完课时内容，点击**下一课时**。
2. 会弹出类似**第 1 课时已完成**的窗口。如果有可用测试，可以点击**知识测试**或**应用测试**。
3. 点击窗口中的**下一课时**继续学习。

faqs.questionEn: Where do I find Check your understanding, and why is my test not available yet?
faqs.answerEn:
1. In a lesson, select **Check your understanding** in the **Deep Learning** panel on the right. This opens the **Understanding** page.
2. Lesson tests open after you complete the lesson. Until then Lesson 1 shows **Available after lesson completion**: select **Next lesson** at the end of the lesson, then choose **Knowledge Test** or **Application Test**.
3. Later lessons show **Unlocks after Lesson 1** and so on. They open once you have completed both tests of the previous lesson. The course **Fluency Test** shows **Coming soon** and cannot be opened yet.

faqs.questionEn: What is the AI Tutor, and where do I find it?
faqs.answerEn:
The AI Tutor is a learning assistant that answers using the course and lesson you are studying.
1. In a lesson, select **Ask AI Tutor** in the **Deep Learning** panel. It is shown only when AI Tutor is available for the course, and you need access to the course.
2. Choose **Lecture** to have the topic explained, or **Socratic** to be guided with questions.
3. Select **New chat** to start again.

AI Tutor answers support your learning and are not professional, legal, medical or financial advice.

AI Tutor 的回答用于辅助学习，不能代替专业、法律、医疗或财务建议。

faqs.questionEn: What are Study Groups, and how do I join one?
faqs.answerEn:
Study Groups let learners on the same Course study together in Live Sessions of up to 6 people.
1. Select **Study Groups** in the top menu and browse **Discover Study Groups**.
2. Open a group and select **Join Now**. No Host approval is needed.
3. You need access to the group's Course to join. Members can enter a Live Session from 10 minutes before it starts, and it begins when the Host selects **Start Live Session**.

2. 打开一个小组，点击**立即加入**，不需要主持人审核。
3. 加入小组需要拥有该小组所属课程的访问权限。成员可以在直播课开始前 10 分钟进入，主持人点击**开始直播课**后直播课才开始。

faqs.questionEn: How do I join a Live Session, and why is there no Join now button yet?
faqs.answerEn:
Live Sessions are in **Study Groups**, not on the course page. You can enter from 10 minutes before the start time.

faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: How do I create a Study Group and schedule a Live Session?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **Study Groups** and select **+ Create Study Group**.
2. Choose a **Related Course** you have access to, enter the **Study Group Title** (up to 50 characters) and **About this Study Group** (up to 200 characters), then select **Create Study Group**. You become the group's Host.
3. In your group, select **Schedule Live Session** and set **Session Title**, **Date**, **Start Time**, **Duration** (30, 45, 60 or 90 mins) and **Maximum Participants** (2 to 6), then select **Schedule Session**.

The Host and members who selected **Plan to Attend** get a reminder in the 10 minutes before the session starts.
faqs.questionZh: 如何创建学习小组并安排直播课？

faqs.questionEn: What plans are available?
faqs.answerEn:
Prices are shown in US dollars on the **Subscription** page. **Everything** and **Category** plans both come in **6 Months** or **12 Months**.
1. **Everything**: all categories, plus anything new added during your plan.
2. **Category**: any one category of your choice; new courses in it are included automatically.
3. Some courses also offer a course-only plan: open the course page and select **View all benefits**.

Each plan shows its **AI Tutor points** and lets you study on 1 PC and 1 mobile device.

1. **全部课程**：所有分类，以及订阅期间新增的内容。
2. **分类课程**：任选一个分类，该分类的新增课程会自动包含。
3. 部分课程还提供单课方案：打开课程页面并选择**查看所有权益**。

每个方案都会显示 **AI Tutor 积分**，并支持 1 台电脑和 1 台移动设备。

faqs.questionEn: How do I choose between a 6-month and a 12-month plan?
faqs.answerEn:

2. Compare the prices. The **Everything** card can also show a struck-through price and a **Save** tag.
3. Select the plan button. On **Confirm your subscription**, check **Pay now**, **Term** (with its start and end dates) and **Next payment** before you continue. The plan renews automatically unless you cancel, and purchases can't be refunded.

faqs.questionEn: Why can't I click Continue on the Confirm your subscription page?
faqs.answerEn:
**Continue** stays greyed out until all three boxes under **Required confirmations** are ticked:
1. "I understand that subscription payments are non-refundable, except where required by law."
2. "I authorise Stripe to charge my payment method each new period until I cancel."
3. "I understand the renewal price may change; I'll be notified by email in advance."

Tick all three, then select **Continue** to go to payment. We email you at least 5 days before each payment.

3. “我了解续订价格可能变更，并会提前收到邮件通知。”

三项都勾选后，点击**继续**进入付款。每次付款前我们至少提前 5 天发邮件通知。

faqs.questionEn: How does the free trial work?
faqs.answerEn:
Some courses offer a three-day trial.
1. Open the course page and select **View all benefits**.
2. If a **Choose a plan** section appears, choose a plan and select **Start three-day trial**. It is not offered on the **Everything** or **Category** cards.
3. **Confirm your subscription** shows **USD 0.00 during the trial** and that a payment method is needed for automatic renewal. Tick the three confirmations, select **Continue** and complete checkout.

If you do not cancel, the paid term follows the trial. A trial can be used once for each plan, and cancelling it ends course access straight away.

如果不取消，试用结束后将开始付费周期。每个方案只能试用一次，取消试用会立即结束课程访问。

faqs.questionEn: How do I cancel my subscription? Will I lose access straight away?
faqs.answerEn:
Cancelling a paid plan turns off auto-renewal; you keep access until the end of the period.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Cancel auto-renewal** on the plan card.
2. Optionally choose a reason, then select **Cancel auto-renewal** in the window. Select **Keep auto-renewal** to change nothing.
3. The card shows **Auto-renewal off**. Your access stays active until the **Valid until** date, and payments already made are non-refundable. To renew again before then, select **Turn on auto-renewal**.

For a free trial the button is **Cancel**, and access ends straight away.

faqs.questionEn: How does auto-renewal work, and can I turn it back on?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel auto-renewal before the renewal date.
2. We email you at least 5 days before each payment. The renewal price may change, and you will be told by email in advance.
3. If you turned auto-renewal off and the plan has not expired, open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Turn on auto-renewal**. It takes effect straight away.
4. After a plan has expired, choose a plan again on **Subscription**.
faqs.questionZh: 自动续订是怎样的？可以重新开启吗？
faqs.answerZh:

2. 每次付款前至少 5 天我们会发邮件通知你。续订价格可能变化，我们会提前通过邮件告知。
3. 如果你关闭了自动续订且订阅尚未到期，请打开**我的学习** > **我的订阅**，点击**开启自动续费**，立即生效。
4. 订阅到期后，请在**订阅**页面重新选择方案。

faqs.questionEn: When does my subscription end, and when is my next payment?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription**. Under **Current subscriptions**, **Valid until** is the end of the current period. Each category has its own date.
2. If the card shows **Active** with **Cancel auto-renewal**, it renews automatically on that date. If it shows **Auto-renewal off**, it will not renew and access ends on that date.
3. If you have **Everything**, the **Subscription** page also shows **Next payment on** with the date and current price.

2. 卡片显示**订阅有效**和**取消自动续订**时，会在该日期自动续订；显示**已取消自动续订**时不会续订，访问权限在该日期结束。
3. 如果你拥有**全部课程**（Everything），**订阅**页面还会显示下次付款日期和当前价格。

faqs.questionEn: How do I change my subscription?
faqs.answerEn:
There is no plan-change or downgrade option. On **Subscription** you can expand your access:
1. To add another category, use the **Add a category** card. Each category has its own end date.
2. If you have only one category, the **Upgrade to Everything** card may be offered. Your end date stays the same.
3. To stop renewing, open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Cancel auto-renewal**.

faqs.questionEn: How do I add another category to my subscription?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **Subscription**. With one category, the page shows **Expand your access** and an **Add a category** card; your category is marked **Owned**. With two categories, it shows **Unlock your last category** instead.
2. Choose the category and **6 Months** or **12 Months**, then select the **Add [category] · [price]** button.
3. On **Confirm your subscription**, tick the three confirmations, select **Continue** and complete the payment.

The new category gets its own card in **My Subscription** with its own **Valid until** date and renewal.

2. 选择分类以及**6 个月**或**12 个月**，然后点击**加购[分类] · [价格]**按钮。
3. 在**确认订阅**页面勾选三项确认，点击**继续**并完成付款。

faqs.questionEn: How do I upgrade to Everything, and why is the button greyed out?
faqs.answerEn:
**Upgrade to Everything** is only offered while you have exactly one **Category** plan that is active with auto-renewal on. With two categories, the page shows **Unlock your last category** instead.
1. Open **Subscription**. The **Upgrade to Everything** card shows the upgrade price for the days left; your end date stays the same.
2. Select **Upgrade · [price]**, review **Confirm your upgrade**, tick the three confirmations and select **Continue**.
3. If the card says "Upgrade is unavailable for this subscription.", select **View subscription details**. If it says "Your upgrade price could not be loaded.", select **Refresh upgrade price**. If it stays unavailable, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type**, describe the problem and select **Submit Enquiry**. Do not include card details.

faqs.questionEn: Where can I find my invoice or receipt?
faqs.answerEn:
Receipts are in **Payment history**.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription**.
2. On the plan card, select **Payment history**.
3. In the **Receipt** column, select **View receipt** next to a payment marked **Paid**. It opens in a new tab as a web page; there is no separate invoice download. If the table is wider than your screen, scroll it sideways.

Free-trial activations (**Trial activation**, **US$0.00**), failed and cancelled payments have no receipt.

faqs.questionEn: I paid but my course is not unlocked yet.
faqs.answerEn:
Access opens once the payment is confirmed, which can take a short while.
1. If you see **Payment is being confirmed**, wait for the page to refresh, or select **Check payment status**.
2. If it shows **Payment was not completed**, no access was granted. Start a new purchase from **Subscription**, or from the course page via **View all benefits**.
3. Once confirmed, your plan appears under **Current subscriptions** in **My Learning** > **My Subscription**. If it is there but the course is still locked, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type**, describe the problem and select **Submit Enquiry**. Do not include card details.

2. 如果显示**支付未完成**，说明没有开通新的权限。请从**订阅**页面，或课程页面的**查看所有权益**重新购买。
3. 付款确认后，你的方案会显示在**我的学习** > **我的订阅**的**当前订阅**下。如果已显示但课程仍未解锁，请点击右上角头像，打开**我的学习**，在左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**），在**问题类型**中选择**支付与订阅**，描述问题后点击**提交问题**。请不要填写银行卡信息。

faqs.questionEn: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answerEn:
Purchases can't be refunded. Subscription payments are non-refundable, except where required by law. The **Subscription** page shows this under **No refunds**, and you confirm it before you pay.
1. Before you pay, check the plan, term and dates on **Confirm your subscription**.
2. If you think you were charged in error, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type**, describe the problem and select **Submit Enquiry**. Do not include card details. Our support team will review it and reply by email.
faqs.questionZh: 可以退款吗？
faqs.answerZh:

1. 付款前，请在**确认订阅**页面核对方案、时长和日期。
2. 如果你认为被错误扣款，请点击右上角头像，打开**我的学习**，在左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**），在**问题类型**中选择**支付与订阅**，描述问题后点击**提交问题**。请不要填写银行卡信息。客服团队会查看并通过邮件回复。

faqs.questionEn: How do I contact support?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **Contact Support**: select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**). You can also select **Contact Support** on the **Help Center / FAQ** page. If you are signed out, you are asked to sign in first.
2. Choose an **Enquiry Type**: **Technical Support**, **Course Content**, **Payments & Subscriptions** or **Other Enquiries**.
3. Fill in **Subject** and **Message**, check **Your Email**, attach files if needed, then select **Submit Enquiry**.

Our support team replies by email, and you can follow your enquiry in **My enquiries**. Please do not share sensitive payment details.

faqs.questionEn: Why does the button say 'Checking for a quick answer…' when I submit my enquiry?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Wait a few seconds. Before the enquiry is sent, the form looks for a quick answer in our help articles.
2. If one is found, the **AI Support Assistant** window opens. Select **Yes, this solved my issue** to stop (no enquiry is sent), **No, still submit to support team** to send it, or **Edit my enquiry** to change your message.
3. If no answer is found, or the check takes too long, your enquiry is sent straight away.

faqs.questionEn: A cookie banner showed up and I want to change my choice. How?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Scroll to the bottom of any page and, under **Support**, select **Cookie settings**.
2. Select **Use essential cookies only** or **Allow optional cookies**. You see "Cookie preference saved."
3. Essential cookies keep sign-in and security working; optional analytics cookies stay off until you allow them.

Your choice is stored in the browser you use, so the banner can appear again in a private window, after clearing site data, or on another browser or device.

你的选择保存在当前浏览器中，因此在无痕窗口、清除网站数据后，或更换浏览器或设备时，提示可能会再次出现。

faqs.questionEn: I signed in on my phone and my computer signed me out. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
1. When you sign in with **Email** and **Password** on one device, your sign-in on your other devices ends. The next time you open a page there, you are sent to the sign-in page.
2. To carry on, sign in again on that device: enter your **Email**, select **Continue**, then enter your **Password** and select **Sign in**. You can also select **Google** or **WeChat** under **Or continue with**.
3. After you sign in, you come back to the page you were on, for example your lesson. Signing in again here ends the sign-in on the other device, so it helps to use one device at a time.

2. 想继续使用那台设备，请重新登录：输入**邮箱**并点击**继续**，再输入**密码**并点击**登录**。也可以在**或使用以下方式继续**下点击 **Google** 或**微信**。
3. 登录后会回到你刚才所在的页面，例如课程页面。需要注意的是，在这里重新登录会结束另一台设备上的登录，所以最好一次只用一台设备。

faqs.questionEn: I think someone else is using my account. What can I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. If you are signed in, select your avatar at the top right and select **Sign out**. On the sign-in page, enter your **Email**, select **Continue**, then select **Forgot password?** and **Send reset email**.
2. Open the reset link in the email within one hour (check your spam folder), enter a new **Password** and **Confirm new password**, then select **Reset password**. Resetting the password ends the sign-ins that were already active on other devices.
3. Sign in again with the new password on your own device.
4. If you still notice anything you do not recognise, select **Learning Guide** at the top left, then select **Contact us** in the **Support** section at the bottom.

faqs.questionEn: I see 'This link is invalid or expired. Return to the binding page to request a new link.' when I confirm my email for WeChat. What do I do?
faqs.answerEn:

2. Enter your email and select **Send verification email**. If one was already sent, wait for the 60-second countdown, then select **Resend verification email**.

faqs.questionEn: The free trial window says 'Payment method required for automatic renewal'. Why does my free trial need a payment method?
faqs.answerEn:
Starting the trial costs nothing today: **Pay now** shows **USD 0.00 during the trial**. The paid term follows the trial and renews automatically unless cancelled, so a payment method is asked for.
1. In **Confirm your subscription**, check **Payment & renewal**. It shows 'Paid term follows the trial period' and 'Renews automatically unless cancelled'.
2. Tick the three boxes under **Required confirmations**.
3. Select **Continue** and complete checkout.

If you do not want the paid term to start, cancel the trial under **My Learning** > **My Subscription** before it ends. Cancelling ends course access straight away.

2. 勾选**必需确认事项**下的三项。
3. 点击**继续**，并完成结账。

如果不想开始付费周期，请在试用结束前到**我的学习** > **我的订阅**中取消试用。取消后课程访问会立即结束。

faqs.questionEn: A page looks broken or out of date, or the buttons do nothing. What can I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Reload the page without the saved copy: press **Ctrl+Shift+R** on Windows or **Cmd+Shift+R** on a Mac (Chrome, Edge and Firefox).
2. Make sure your browser is up to date, or try another up-to-date browser. Learning Guide does not warn you when a browser is too old, so a broken page can be a sign it needs updating.
3. If it still looks wrong, clear the saved images and files for this site in your browser settings, then open the page again. This can sign you out, so you may need to sign in again.
4. If it is still not right, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, tell us which browser and version you use, and attach a screenshot.
faqs.questionZh: 页面显示错乱、还是旧样子，或者按钮点了没反应，怎么办？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 强制刷新页面，让浏览器重新加载：Windows 上按 **Ctrl+Shift+R**，Mac 上按 **Cmd+Shift+R**（适用于 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox）。
2. 确认浏览器是最新版本，或者换一个最新版的浏览器试试。浏览器版本过低时 Learning Guide 不会弹出提醒，所以页面错乱可能就是浏览器需要更新了。
3. 仍然不对，请在浏览器设置里清除本网站保存的图片和文件，再重新打开页面。这样可能会让你退出登录，需要重新登录。
4. 还是不行，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**，在**问题类型**里选择**技术支持**，告诉我们你用的浏览器和版本，并附上截图。

faqs.questionEn: Learning Guide emails never reach my work or school inbox. What can I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Check the junk, spam and quarantine folders in that mailbox, and search for **Learning Guide**.
2. Look for these subjects: **Learning Guide account confirmation**, **Learning Guide password reset**, **Verify and bind your email** and **Live Session reminder**. Support replies start with your enquiry number in square brackets. If your account is in Chinese, the subjects are in Chinese, for example **Learning Guide 账号确认**.
3. Ask your IT team to let mail from Learning Guide through to your address and to release any held messages with those subjects.
4. If nothing arrives, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, and tell us which email address you use and that your work or school mail may be filtering messages. If you cannot sign in, use **Contact us** under **Support** at the bottom of the home page instead.

faqs.questionEn: My school or company network seems to block the Live Session. What can I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Turn off any VPN or proxy, then reload the Live Session page. If you see "The Live Session could not connect. Check the connection and try again.", select **Reconnect**.
2. Try another network, such as your phone's hotspot, to see whether the school or company network is the cause.
3. If the Live Session works on the other network, ask your IT team to allow Learning Guide and the live audio and video connection that Live Sessions use.
4. If it fails on every network, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, and include the Study Group name, the session time and the network you are using.

faqs.questionEn: I hear an echo, or my own voice comes back, in a Live Session. How do I stop it?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Use headphones or earphones, so the sound from your speakers does not go back into your microphone.
2. Select **Mic** to switch your microphone off while you are listening, and switch it on only when you speak.
3. Ask the others on the call to use headphones too, and close any other tabs or apps that are in a call.
4. If the echo carries on, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, and tell us which device and browser you use.

4. 回声还是没有消失，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**，在**问题类型**里选择**技术支持**，并告诉我们你用的设备和浏览器。

faqs.questionEn: The Live Session says 'Your network connection is weak. Trying to reconnect…'. What should I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Keep the Live Session page open. While you see this message the page is trying to reconnect by itself, so you do not need to refresh.
2. Move closer to your Wi-Fi router or switch to a stronger network, and pause big downloads or videos on other tabs and devices.
3. If it later shows "The Live Session could not connect. Check the connection and try again." or "The connection failed. Check your network and try again.", select **Reconnect**.
4. If it keeps happening, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, and tell us the Study Group name and the session time.

faqs.questionEn: The Live Session says 'The connection failed' or 'could not connect', and I cannot get in. What do I do?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Select **Reconnect**. The page also tries again by itself, waiting a little longer each time.
2. Check your network: switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, or turn off your VPN, then select **Reconnect** again.
3. Make sure the session is still on. If it has finished, you will see **Thanks for studying together** and a **Return to Course** button instead, and a finished session cannot be joined again.
4. If it still fails, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, and send the Study Group name, the session time and the message you see.

faqs.questionEn: Screen sharing did not start in my Live Session. What do I do?
faqs.answerEn:
**Share** works only once the room has connected, and only in a browser that can share a screen (phones and some other browsers cannot, so the button is not shown there).
1. Select **Share** again and choose a window or screen in the picker your browser shows. If you close that picker without choosing, no error appears.
2. If you see "Screen sharing did not start. Check that this browser may share your screen, then try again.", your computer may be blocking the browser. On a Mac, open **System Settings**, then **Privacy & Security**, then **Screen Recording** (called **Screen & System Audio Recording** on newer versions), switch your browser on, then quit the browser fully and open it again.
3. Go back to the Live Session and select **Share** again. To clear the message, select **Close**.
4. If it still does not start, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support** as the **Enquiry Type**, and tell us which browser and computer you use.

faqs.answerZh:

1. 再点一次**共享屏幕**，在浏览器弹出的选择窗口里选好要共享的窗口或屏幕。如果你没选就把这个窗口关掉了，页面不会报错。
2. 如果看到“屏幕共享没有开始。请确认浏览器允许共享屏幕后重试。”，可能是电脑系统拦住了浏览器。在 Mac 上，打开**系统设置**，进入**隐私与安全性**，找到**屏幕录制**（新版本里叫**屏幕与系统音频录制**），把你的浏览器打开，然后完全退出浏览器，再重新打开。
3. 回到直播课，再点一次**共享屏幕**。想关掉这条提示，点击**关闭**。
4. 还是不能开始共享，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**，在**问题类型**里选择**技术支持**，并告诉我们你用的浏览器和电脑。

faqs.questionEn: The Live Session time on the Study Groups page is not the time my host gave me. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Session times are shown in the time zone of your own device, so the same moment can show a different hour in another country. For example, 15:30 – 16:30 on 30 Oct 2026 in New York is 03:30 – 04:30 on 31 Oct 2026 in Shanghai.
2. Look at the date and time on the session card in **Study Groups**, and compare it with the time zone your host is using.
3. Check the date, time and time zone settings on your computer or phone. If they are wrong, correct them and reopen **Study Groups**.
4. If the time still looks wrong, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, and tell us the Study Group name and the date and time shown on the card.

2. 在**学习小组**里查看直播课卡片上的日期和时间，并和主持人使用的时区对一下。
3. 检查电脑或手机上的日期、时间和时区设置。如果不对，改正后重新打开**学习小组**。
4. 时间还是不对，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**，告诉我们学习小组名称，以及卡片上显示的日期和时间。

faqs.questionEn: I scheduled a Live Session in my own time zone, but members in another country see a different time. Is that wrong?
faqs.answerEn:
1. No, that is expected. The **Date** and **Start Time** you enter in the **Schedule Live Session** form are read in your device's time zone, and each member sees the same moment in their own time zone.
2. Before you save, check the **Date** and **Start Time** against the clock on your own device.
3. When you tell members the time, add the time zone, for example "3:30 pm New York time", so everyone can match it to their own clock.
4. To move the time before the session starts, select **Edit Session**, change the **Date** or **Start Time**, and select **Save**.

2. 保存前，请对照你自己设备上的时间，检查**日期**和**开始时间**。
3. 告诉成员时间时，请注明时区，比如“纽约时间下午 3:30”，方便大家换算成自己那边的时间。
4. 直播课开始前如果要改时间，请点击**编辑本节**，修改**日期**或**开始时间**，再点击**保存**。

1. 正常。页面顶部的 **EN** / **中** 切换只改变你当前浏览页面的语言，不会更改**个人设置**里保存的**语言**。
2. 如需修改保存的语言，请点击右上角的头像，打开**个人设置**。
3. 在**语言**下选择**简体中文**，然后点击**保存修改**。
4. 页面会以简体中文重新加载。

faqs.questionEn: Can I put my name in Chinese characters?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes.
1. Select your avatar at the top right, then open **Personal settings**.
2. In **Name**, type your name in Chinese, for example 张伟, or mix Chinese and English, for example 张伟 Zhang. Use 1 to 50 letters or numbers. Spaces, hyphens (-), apostrophes (') and middle dots (·) are allowed.
3. Select **Save changes**. You should see “Settings saved.”
faqs.questionZh: 我的姓名可以用中文吗？
faqs.answerZh:
可以。
1. 点击右上角的头像，选择**个人设置**。
2. 在**姓名**中输入中文名字，例如“张伟”，也可以中英文混合，例如“张伟 Zhang”。姓名需为 1 到 50 个文字或数字字符，可使用空格、连字符 (-)、撇号 (') 和间隔号 (·)。
3. 点击**保存修改**，页面会显示“设置已保存。”

faqs.questionEn: The sign-up tick box says Terms of Use and Privacy Notice. Where can I read them?
faqs.answerEn:
1. On the sign-up page, the tick box says you accept **Terms of Use** and **Privacy Notice**. On that page these names are plain bold text, not links.
2. To read the published pages, scroll to the bottom of any page. Under **Legal**, select **Privacy Policy** or **Terms of Service**.
3. The names in the tick box and in the footer are not the same. If you need to know exactly which document you agreed to, select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu of My Learning (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

faqs.questionEn: What personal information does Learning Guide keep about me?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Select **Privacy Policy** under **Legal** at the bottom of any page.
2. The policy says Learning Guide keeps the account information needed to sign you in, and links your learning progress, subscriptions and access to your user ID.
3. It says Stripe handles card details on its hosted pages, and Learning Guide does not store full card numbers or CVCs.
4. To ask about your account information, select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu of My Learning (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

faqs.questionEn: How do I see which devices are signed in to my account, or sign out another device?
faqs.answerEn:
1. **Personal settings** has no device list and no option to sign out other devices.
2. When you sign in with your **Email** and **Password**, the sign-ins on your other devices end.
3. To sign out on the device you are using, select your avatar at the top right, then select **Sign out**.
4. If you are worried about your account, select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu of My Learning (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**) and tell us what happened.
faqs.questionZh: 我怎么查看哪些设备登录了我的账号，或者退出其他设备？
faqs.answerZh:

2. 使用**邮箱**和**密码**登录时，你在其他设备上的登录会结束。
3. 如需退出当前使用的设备，请点击右上角的头像，选择**退出登录**。
4. 如果你担心账号安全，请在“我的学习”左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**），告诉我们发生了什么。

faqs.questionEn: A cookie box covers the bottom of the page and I can't reach the button under it. How do I close it?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The box has no separate close button. Select **Use essential cookies only** or **Allow optional cookies** and it closes.
2. Your choice is saved in this browser, so the box does not come back when you reload the page.
3. Then carry on with the button that was covered, for example **Join for Free** or **Save changes**.

You can change your choice later with **Cookie settings** under **Support** at the bottom of any page.

2. 你的选择会保存在当前浏览器中，刷新页面后提示不会再出现。
3. 然后继续点击刚才被挡住的按钮，例如**免费加入**或**保存修改**。

之后如需更改选择，可在任意页面底部的**支持**下点击 **Cookie 设置**。

faqs.questionEn: How do I see only one category of courses?
faqs.answerEn:
Use the category tabs above the course cards.
1. Open **Courses** in the top menu.
2. Select a tab: **All Courses**, **Chinese Humanities**, **European Humanities** or **Science**. The cards change to that category.
3. If a tab shows **No published courses are available yet.**, no course is published in that category right now. Select **All Courses** to see everything that is available.

faqs.questionEn: My progress shows 50% after I finished one lesson. How is progress worked out?
faqs.answerEn:
The percentage on your **My Learning** card shows how far through the course you have got in the mode you are using (**Video Mode** or **Text Mode**). It goes up as you complete lessons, and it does not go down if you reopen an earlier lesson.
1. Open **My Learning** from your avatar menu. The card shows your current lesson, for example **Current: Lesson 1**, and your percentage.
2. Finish the last lesson. The card then shows **Completed** and **100%**.
3. Tests are counted separately. The **Understanding** page has its own count, for example **0 of 4 completed**, and you do not need to take the tests for the card to reach 100%.
faqs.questionZh: 学完一节课后进度只显示 50%，进度是怎么算的？
faqs.answerZh:
**我的学习**卡片上的百分比，表示你在当前学习模式（**视频模式**或**文本模式**）下学到了课程的哪个位置。完成课时后它会上涨，回看前面的课时不会让它下降。
1. 从头像菜单打开**我的学习**，卡片会显示你当前所在的课时，例如**当前：第 1 课时**，以及百分比。
2. 完成最后一个课时后，卡片会显示**已完成**和 **100%**。
3. 测试是单独统计的。**理解测试**页面有自己的计数，例如**已完成 0 / 4**；不做测试，卡片也可以达到 100%。

faqs.questionEn: A window called Complete Course opened after my last lesson. Is the course finished?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. Your progress is saved before the window opens, so the course already counts as finished.
1. On the last lesson, select **Next lesson**. The **Complete Course** window opens and says **Check your understanding, or return to My Learning.**
2. If you like, select **Knowledge Test** or **Application Test** first. You can also skip them.
3. Select **Complete Course** to go to **My Learning**, where the card shows **Completed**, **100%** and **Review Course**. Closing the window with the **X** works too.

2. 你可以先选择**知识测试**或**应用测试**，也可以直接跳过。
3. 点击**完成课程**，就会回到**我的学习**，卡片上会显示**已完成**、**100%** 和**回顾课程**。直接关闭窗口也可以。

faqs.questionEn: I clicked Next lesson and the button says Updating... or I see 'Your progress could not be saved'. What do I do?
faqs.answerEn:
Your lesson is saved when the **Lesson 1 completed** window opens (on the last lesson the window is titled **Complete Course**).
1. Wait while the **Next lesson** button shows **Updating...**.
2. If you see **Your progress could not be saved. Please try again.** under the button, select **Next lesson** again.
3. If it keeps failing, refresh the page and try once more. If it still fails, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), and tell us which lesson it is.

faqs.questionEn: I watched the whole video but did not see a Mark complete button. Is my lesson saved?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. You do not need to press anything. When the video reaches its end, the lesson is saved automatically and a window such as **Lesson 1 completed** opens.
1. Play the video to the end. Near the end (from about 98% watched) a small bar with the percentage and **Mark complete** appears next to the lesson title, in case you want to mark it yourself.
2. When the video ends, the bar changes to **Completed** and the **Lesson 1 completed** window opens.
3. Select **Next lesson** to continue, or open **Knowledge Test** or **Application Test** first.

2. 视频播完后，小条会变成**已完成**，同时弹出“第 1 课时已完成”窗口。
3. 点击**下一课时**继续学习，也可以先选择**知识测试**或**应用测试**。

faqs.questionEn: How do I change the video speed?
faqs.answerEn:
The speed menu is in the control bar under the video.
1. Find the **1×** menu on the right of the control bar, between the volume button and the picture-in-picture and full-screen icons.
2. Select it and choose a speed from **0.5×** to **2×**, for example **1.25×** or **1.5×**.
3. To go back to normal speed, choose **1×**.
faqs.questionZh: 视频怎么调节播放速度？
faqs.answerZh:
速度菜单在视频下方的控制栏里。
1. 在控制栏右侧找到 **1×** 菜单，它位于音量按钮和画中画、全屏图标之间。
2. 点击它，选择 **0.5×** 到 **2×** 之间的速度，例如 **1.25×** 或 **1.5×**。
3. 想恢复正常速度，选择 **1×** 即可。

faqs.questionEn: When I open my video again it starts from the beginning. Does it remember where I stopped?
faqs.answerEn:
No. The video does not remember the exact second you stopped at, so it starts again from the beginning when you reopen the lesson. You can jump to the part you want with the seek bar.
1. Open **My Learning** and select **Resume Learning** on the course card to go back to your lesson.
2. Select the play button.
3. Drag the seek bar under the video to the part you want. It helps to note the time shown next to the seek bar before you leave.

1. 打开**我的学习**，点击课程卡片上的**继续学习**，回到你的课时。
2. 点击播放按钮。
3. 拖动视频下方的进度条，跳到你想看的位置。离开前记下进度条旁边显示的时间，会方便很多。

faqs.questionEn: How do I get back to the course page or the Courses list from a lesson?
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: Why are the course title and lesson text in English when I use the Chinese site?
faqs.answerEn:
Menus, buttons and labels follow the site language, but course titles, descriptions and lesson text are shown in the language the course was written in. Switching the site language does not translate them.
1. Check the language button at the top right. On the Chinese site it reads 中, and labels such as **开始学习** and **课程大纲** appear in Chinese.
2. The course title, description, lesson titles and lesson text stay as written for that course.
3. If you cannot find a course in the language you need, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

faqs.questionEn: Why can't I change the title, duration or maximum participants of my Live Session?
faqs.answerEn:
Once a Live Session is scheduled, its details are locked so they stay as members planned for. You can still change the **Date** and **Start Time**.
1. Open **Study Groups** and select your group from **My Study Groups**.
2. On the session card, select **Edit Session**.
3. **Session Title**, **Related Lesson**, **Duration**, **Maximum Participants** and **Session Focus** are greyed out and cannot be edited. Change **Date** or **Start Time** if you need to, then select **Save**.

To change any of the greyed-out details, select **Cancel Session** and schedule a new session with **Schedule Live Session**.

faqs.answerZh:

1. 打开**学习小组**，从**我的学习小组**中选择你的小组。
2. 在直播课卡片上点击**编辑本节**。
3. **直播课标题**、**相关课时**、**时长**、**最多参与人数**和**本节重点**会显示为灰色，不能修改。需要的话，修改**日期**或**开始时间**，然后点击**保存**。

如果想改灰色的这些内容，请点击**取消本节**，再用**安排直播课**重新安排一节。

faqs.questionEn: How do I cancel a Live Session I scheduled?
faqs.answerEn:
Only the Host can cancel a Live Session, and only before it starts. Cancelling removes it from the Study Group.
1. Open **Study Groups** and select your group from **My Study Groups**.
2. On the session card, select **Cancel Session**.
3. In **Cancel this Live Session?**, select **Yes, cancel session**. Select **Go back** if you want to keep it.

If you only need a different time, select **Edit Session** and change the **Date** or **Start Time** instead.

只有主持人可以取消直播课，而且要在直播课开始之前。取消后，这节直播课会从学习小组中移除。
1. 打开**学习小组**，从**我的学习小组**中选择你的小组。
2. 在直播课卡片上点击**取消本节**。
3. 在“取消这节直播课？”中点击**确认取消本节**。如想保留，请点击**返回**。

如果只是需要改时间，请点击**编辑本节**，修改**日期**或**开始时间**。

faqs.questionEn: How do I cancel my Study Group?
faqs.answerEn:
Only the Host can cancel a Study Group.
1. Open **Study Groups** and select your group from **My Study Groups**.
2. Under the **Members** list, select **Cancel Group**.
3. In **Cancel this Study Group?**, select **Yes, cancel group**. Select **Go back** to keep it.

The dialog says that upcoming Live Sessions will be removed, a Live Session that is already open will end, and members will be notified. Afterwards the group no longer appears in members' lists.

faqs.questionEn: How do I change my Study Group's title or description?
faqs.answerEn:
The Host can change the **Study Group Title** and **About this Study Group**. The **Related Course** cannot be changed.
1. Open **Study Groups** and select your group from **My Study Groups**.
2. Select **Edit Group**.
3. Change the title (up to 50 characters) or the description (up to 200 characters). **Related Course** is shown as text only.
4. Select **Save**.

To study a different course, create a new Study Group with **Create Study Group**.

faqs.questionEn: I can't make the Live Session any more. How do I remove my Plan to Attend?
faqs.answerEn:
**Plan to Attend** only records that you plan to come and gets you a reminder. It does not reserve a place, so cancelling it does not affect anyone else.
1. Open **Study Groups** and select your group from **My Study Groups**.
2. On the session card, select **Cancel Attendance**.

The card goes back to showing **Plan to Attend**, and the line **You'll get a reminder before it starts** disappears. If your plans change again, select **Plan to Attend** again.

faqs.questionEn: How do I leave a Live Session, and can I come back?
faqs.answerEn:
You can leave a Live Session and come back while it is still live.
1. In the session room, select **Leave Session**.
2. In **Leave this Live Session?**, select **Yes, leave**. To stay, select **Go back**.
3. The page then says **You left the Live Session.** To come back while the session is still live, select **Rejoin**, or select **Join now** on the session card in your Study Group. If every place has been taken in the meantime, the card shows **Session full**.

If you are the last person in the room, the dialog says leaving ends the Live Session, and it cannot be joined again.

如果你是最后一位在场的人，对话框会提示离开后这节直播课就会结束，之后无法再加入。

faqs.questionEn: What is Session Focus, and can my members see it?
faqs.answerEn:
**Session Focus** is an optional note of up to 50 characters that says what the session is about, such as the chapter to read.
1. In **Schedule Live Session**, type the note in **Session Focus**.
2. Select **Schedule Session**. Members see the note on the session card, under the session title.
3. You cannot change **Session Focus** after the session is scheduled. To change it, select **Cancel Session** and schedule a new one.

faqs.questionEn: Do I have to choose a Related Lesson when I schedule a session?
faqs.answerEn:
No. **Related Lesson** is optional. Pick a lesson from the course if you want the session linked to it, or leave **Select Lesson** as it is.
1. In **Schedule Live Session**, open **Related Lesson** and choose a lesson, or leave **Select Lesson**.
2. Fill in the required fields (marked with *): **Session Title**, **Date**, **Start Time**, **Duration** and **Maximum Participants**.
3. Select **Schedule Session**. If you picked a lesson, its name shows on the session card.

3. 点击**安排本节**。如果选了课时，它的名称会显示在直播课卡片上。

faqs.questionEn: The Host moved my Live Session to a different time. Am I still signed up?
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: Do I need an account just to look at the plans and prices?
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: Do I have to pay for all 12 months at once?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. The first term is charged in one payment, and the plan then renews automatically unless you cancel. The **Subscription** page offers **6 Months** or **12 Months**, with no monthly option.
1. Open **Subscription** and select **12 Months** above the plan cards to see the 12-month price.
2. On **Confirm your subscription**, check **Pay now**. It shows the amount with the line **Charged now for your first 12 months**.
3. Check **Term** (the start and end dates) and **Next payment** before you continue.

faqs.questionEn: The Term end date on Confirm your subscription and Valid until in My Subscription do not match. Which is right?
faqs.answerEn:
They are the same renewal, shown in two places. The term ends one day before the next payment.
1. On **Confirm your subscription**, **Term** shows the first term's start and end dates, and **Next payment** shows the renewal date.
2. In **My Learning** > **My Subscription**, **Valid until** shows the renewal date, which is one day after the **Term** end date.
3. The plan renews on that date unless you cancel auto-renewal first. If you cancel, your access continues until **Valid until**.
faqs.questionZh: “确认订阅”里的时长结束日期和“我的订阅”里的有效期至对不上，哪个是对的？
faqs.answerZh:
两处日期对应同一个续订时间，只是显示位置不同。
1. 在**确认订阅**页面，**时长**显示首个周期的起止日期，**下次付款**显示续订日期。
2. 在**我的学习** > **我的订阅**中，**有效期至**显示的是续订日期，比**时长**的结束日期晚一天。
3. 除非你在该日期前取消自动续订，否则会在这一天续订。取消后，访问权限会持续到**有效期至**。

faqs.questionEn: I'm on my free trial. Do I need to cancel it before I buy a plan?
faqs.answerEn:
You can buy a plan while your trial is running. You do not have to cancel the trial first.
1. Open the course page, select **View all benefits**, choose a plan under **Choose a plan** and select **Continue to purchase**.
2. On **Confirm your subscription**, tick the three **Required confirmations**, select **Continue** and complete payment.
3. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription**. If you bought the same plan you were trialling, the new plan is under **Current subscriptions** and the trial moves to **Past subscriptions** with the status **Expired**.
4. If you bought a different plan, such as a **Category** plan, the trial card can stay under **Current subscriptions** with **Trial** and **Cancel** until its **Valid until** date. Buying the other plan does not cancel the trial for you. If you do not want the trial's paid term to follow, select **Cancel** on its card. Trial access then ends straight away.
faqs.questionZh: 我正在免费试用，买正式方案前需要先取消试用吗？

1. 打开课程页面，选择**查看所有权益**，在**选择计划**中选好方案，点击**继续购买**。
2. 在**确认订阅**页面勾选三项**必需确认事项**，点击**继续**并完成付款。
3. 打开**我的学习** > **我的订阅**。如果你买的是正在试用的同一个方案，新方案会显示在**当前订阅**下，试用会移到**历史订阅**，状态为**订阅已过期**。
4. 如果买的是其他方案（例如**分类课程**），试用卡片可能仍留在**当前订阅**中，显示**试用**和**取消**，直到**有效期至**的日期。购买其他方案不会自动取消试用。如果不想在试用结束后开始该方案的付费周期，请在卡片上点击**取消**，试用访问会立即结束。

faqs.questionEn: My Payment history has a Failed row next to my Paid row. Did my plan fail?
faqs.answerEn:
No. A **Failed** row is one payment attempt that did not go through. It does not mean your plan failed.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Payment history** on the plan card.
2. The **Paid** row shows the **Valid period** it covers and a **View receipt** link. That payment is the one that gives you access.
3. The **Failed** row shows **—** under **Valid period** and **Receipt**, so it has no receipt and adds no access.
4. If you think a failed attempt was charged to your card, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type**, describe the problem and select **Submit Enquiry**. Do not include card details.
faqs.questionZh: 付款记录里有一行“失败”，旁边还有“已支付”。是不是我的订阅失败了？
faqs.answerZh:
不是。**失败**表示有一次付款没有完成，并不表示你的订阅失败。
1. 打开**我的学习** > **我的订阅**，在方案卡片上点击**付款记录**。
2. **已支付**那一行显示它覆盖的**有效期**，并有**查看收据**。这笔付款就是开通你访问权限的付款。
3. **失败**那一行的**有效期**和**收据**都显示**—**，没有收据，也不会增加访问权限。
4. 如果你认为失败的那次付款被扣了款，请点击右上角头像，打开**我的学习**，在左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**），在**问题类型**中选择**支付与订阅**，描述问题后点击**提交问题**。请不要填写银行卡信息。

faqs.questionEn: Payment history shows Trial activation for US$0.00. Was I charged?
faqs.answerEn:
That row is the record of starting your trial. Its amount is US$0.00.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Payment history** on the **Trial** card.
2. The **Trial activation** row shows **US$0.00** under **Amount**, and **—** under **Valid period** and **Receipt**. Trial activations have no receipt.
3. When you started the trial, **Confirm your subscription** showed **USD 0.00 during the trial** and said the paid term follows the trial period and renews automatically unless cancelled. If you do not want that, select **Cancel** on the **Trial** card. Trial access then ends straight away.

3. 开始试用时，**确认订阅**页面显示**试用期间 USD 0.00**，并说明试用期结束后开始付费周期，除非取消否则自动续订。如果不想这样，请在**试用**卡片上点击**取消**，试用访问会立即结束。

faqs.questionEn: On Subscription, Upgrade to Everything shows AI Tutor points like 1,500 (+1,000). What does the bracket mean?
faqs.answerEn:
The first number is the total AI Tutor points for **Everything**. The number in brackets is how many more points that is than your current category plan.
1. Open **Subscription**. If you have one category, the page is called **Expand your access**.
2. On the **Upgrade to Everything** card, read **AI Tutor points**. For example, 1,500 (+1,000) means 1,000 more than a category plan with 500 points.
3. The **Add a category** card shows just its own total, with no brackets.
The numbers on your own page are the ones that apply to you.

第一个数字是**升级至 Everything** 后 AI Tutor 积分的总数，括号里的数字是比你当前分类课程订阅多出的积分。
1. 打开**订阅**页面。如果你有一个分类，页面标题是**拓展你的学习范围**。
2. 在**升级至 Everything**卡片上查看 **AI Tutor 积分**。例如 1,500 (+1,000) 表示比 500 积分的分类订阅多 1,000 积分。
3. **加购一个分类**卡片只显示它自己的总数，没有括号。
具体数字以你页面上显示的为准。

faqs.questionEn: The Confirm your subscription page says the quote has expired. What do I do?
faqs.answerEn:
The price on **Confirm your subscription** is held for about 15 minutes. If the window stays open longer, **Continue** shows "This quote or checkout has expired. Please select your plan again."
1. Select the close button at the top right of the window. You are taken back to **Subscription**.
2. Choose your plan again and select its button.
3. On **Confirm your subscription**, tick the three **Required confirmations** and select **Continue**.
If you open an old confirmation link later, the page also sends you back to **Subscription**.

1. 点击窗口右上角的关闭按钮，你会回到**订阅**页面。
2. 重新选择方案并点击方案按钮。
3. 在**确认订阅**页面勾选三项**必需确认事项**，然后点击**继续**。
如果之后打开的是旧的确认链接，页面同样会返回**订阅**页面。

faqs.questionEn: My Subscription says Auto-renewal off. Has my plan been cancelled?
faqs.answerEn:
Not yet. **Auto-renewal off** means the plan will not renew, but you keep access until the date under **Valid until**.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and check the plan card.
2. To keep the plan going, select **Turn on auto-renewal** while the plan has not expired.
3. The other labels: **Active** means it renews automatically (the button is **Cancel auto-renewal**). **Trial** is a free trial (the button is **Cancel**). **Payment failed** shows **Grace period until** and **Pay now**.
4. Under **Past subscriptions**, **Expired** or **Cancelled** with an **Expired on** date means the plan has ended and the card has no buttons. To learn again, choose a plan on **Subscription**.

faqs.answerZh:
还没有。**已取消自动续订**表示方案不会再续订，但在**有效期至**的日期之前你仍可使用。

2. 如果想继续订阅，在方案到期前点击**开启自动续费**。
3. 其他状态：**订阅有效**表示会自动续订（按钮是**取消自动续订**）；**试用**是免费试用（按钮是**取消**）；**付款失败**会显示**宽限期结束日期**和**立即支付**。
4. 在**历史订阅**中，显示**订阅已过期**或**已取消**以及**过期日期**，表示方案已结束，卡片上没有按钮。如需继续学习，请在**订阅**页面重新选择方案。

faqs.questionEn: I cancelled my trial by mistake. Can I undo it?
faqs.answerEn:
There is no undo button. Trial access ended when you confirmed, and the same trial can't be started again.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Past subscriptions**. The trial shows **Cancelled** with an **Expired on** date and no buttons.
2. To keep learning, open the course page, select **View all benefits**, choose a plan and select **Continue to purchase**.
3. If the cancellation was a mistake and you want us to look at it, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**), choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type**, describe what happened and select **Submit Enquiry**. Do not include card details.

faqs.answerZh:
没有撤销按钮。你确认取消后，试用访问已经结束，同一个试用也不能再次开始。
1. 打开**我的学习** > **我的订阅**，展开**历史订阅**。该试用显示**已取消**和**过期日期**，没有按钮。
2. 如需继续学习，打开课程页面，选择**查看所有权益**，选好方案后点击**继续购买**。
3. 如果取消是误操作，希望我们帮你看看，请点击右上角头像，打开**我的学习**，在左侧菜单底部的**联系我们**区域点击**联系客服**（使用手机时，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**），在**问题类型**中选择**支付与订阅**，说明情况后点击**提交问题**。请不要填写银行卡信息。

faqs.questionEn: Which Enquiry Type should I choose for my problem?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **Contact Support**. **Enquiry Type** is already set to **Technical Support**, and you need one selected to send the enquiry.
2. Pick the one closest to your problem: **Technical Support**, **Course Content**, **Payments & Subscriptions** or **Other Enquiries**. For example, sign-in or video problems fit **Technical Support**, and a payment or order fits **Payments & Subscriptions**. Ideas for Learning Guide fit **Other Enquiries**.
3. Fill in **Subject** and **Message**, then select **Submit Enquiry**.

faqs.questionEn: Can I have support reply to a different email address from my account?

faqs.questionEn: I typed my enquiry and then left the page. Is it saved?
faqs.answerEn:
1. No. The Contact Support form does not keep a draft, so what you typed is lost when you leave the page.
2. Before you leave, copy your **Subject** and **Message** somewhere safe.
3. If you do not want to send it, select **Cancel**. Nothing is sent.
4. When you are ready, go back to **Contact Support**, fill in the form again and select **Submit Enquiry**.

3. 如果不想发送，请点击**取消**，不会提交任何问题。
4. 准备好后，回到**联系客服**重新填写，然后点击**提交问题**。

faqs.questionEn: Why does my enquiry say the Subject or Message is too long?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The **Subject** can be up to 120 characters. The box lets you type more, but when you select **Submit Enquiry** the form shows "Enter a subject of up to 120 characters."
2. Shorten the **Subject**, then select **Submit Enquiry** again.
3. The **Message** can be up to 5,000 characters. If it is longer, the form shows "Enter a message of up to 5,000 characters." Shorten it, or send the extra details after the enquiry is sent, in **Your reply** (each reply can also be up to 5,000 characters).

faqs.answerZh:
1. **主题**最多 120 个字符。输入框允许你继续输入，但点击**提交问题**时会提示“请填写主题，最多 120 个字符。”
2. 把**主题**缩短到 120 个字符以内，然后再次点击**提交问题**。
3. **详细描述**最多 5000 个字符。超出时会提示“请填写详细描述，最多 5000 个字符。”请缩短内容；也可以在问题提交后，把补充的内容写在**你的回复**中（每条回复同样最多 5000 个字符）。

faqs.questionEn: Can I edit my enquiry after I have sent it?
faqs.answerEn:

2. To add details, type them in **Your reply** and select **Send**.
3. To start again with different wording, withdraw the enquiry while its status is **Submitted**: select **Withdraw**, then **Withdraw enquiry**. Then send a new enquiry from **Contact Support**.

faqs.questionEn: I see 'This request was updated, please check again.' What does it mean?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The enquiry changed after you opened the page. For example, our support team replied or changed its status, or you withdrew it in another tab.
2. The page reloads the enquiry with its latest status, and your message or action was not sent.
3. Read the latest status. If you can still reply, check your text in **Your reply** and select **Send** again. If it now says **Withdrawn**, you cannot reply to it, so send a new enquiry from **Contact Support**.

3. 请先查看最新状态。如果仍可回复，请检查**你的回复**中的内容，再次点击**发送**。如果状态已变为**已撤回**，就不能再回复，请在**联系客服**中提交新的问题。

faqs.questionEn: The AI Support Assistant says it could not find an answer. What do I do now?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The **AI Support Assistant** answers from our FAQs. If none matches, it says: "I couldn’t find an answer to that in our FAQs. Please submit an enquiry using the form and our support team will help."
2. Try again with plainer words. If you see **You might be asking:** or **Try asking one of these:**, you can also pick one of those questions.
3. If you still need help, fill in the **Contact Support** form and select **Submit Enquiry**. Our support team replies by email.

faqs.questionEn: I don't remember which email I signed up with. How do I find my account?
faqs.answerEn:
The sign-in page only checks the exact address you type, so try the addresses you use most.
1. Enter one address on the sign-in page and select **Continue**.
2. If the password step opens, that address has your account. If the **Check your email** page opens, the account exists but is not activated yet. If the **Join for Free** page opens, that address has no account, so select **Sign in** there and try another one.
3. If you used **Google** or **WeChat**, select that button under **Or continue with** instead.
4. If none of them works, select **Learning Guide** at the top left, then **Contact us** in the **Support** section at the bottom, and send the form with the addresses you tried.

3. 如果你之前用的是 **Google** 或**微信**，请在**或使用以下方式继续**下点击对应的按钮。
4. 都不行的话，点击左上角的 **Learning Guide** 回到首页，再点击页面底部**支持**区域的**联系我们**，在表单里写上你试过的邮箱，然后提交。

faqs.questionEn: I signed up but never opened the activation email. Could that be why?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. The account must be activated before you can sign in, and until then a sign-in attempt can show the same message.
1. Enter your email on the sign-in page and select **Continue**. If the **Check your email** page opens, select **Resend activation email** once the countdown ends.
2. Open the newest email within 24 hours. Older activation links stop working.
3. Or select **Forgot password?** and set a new password from the reset email. Opening that link also activates the account.

2. 在 24 小时内打开最新一封邮件里的链接。旧的激活链接会失效。
3. 也可以点击**忘记密码？**，通过重置邮件设置新密码。打开那封邮件里的链接，同样会激活账号。

faqs.questionEn: My password is longer than 30 characters and I can't type all of it. What should I do?
faqs.answerEn:
The **Password** box on the sign-in page accepts up to 30 characters, even though sign-up allowed up to 72, so a longer password cannot be typed in full there.
1. Select **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page and select **Send reset email**.
2. Open the link within one hour. Enter a new **Password** of 8 to 30 characters, and the same in **Confirm new password**.
3. Select **Reset password**, then sign in with the new password.

登录页的**密码**框最多只能输入 30 个字符（注册时允许最多 72 个），所以超过 30 位的密码无法在这里完整输入。

faqs.questionEn: I clicked Block by mistake. How do I let the microphone and camera work again?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Select the icon beside the address bar (usually a lock or site settings icon).
2. Set the microphone and camera for this site to Allow. The exact names depend on your browser.
3. Back in the Live Session, select **Mic** or **Camera** again.
4. If it is still blocked, allow your browser to use the camera and microphone in your device's privacy settings. If you see "No camera or microphone was found, or the device is in use by another application", close the other app and try again.

2. 将本站的麦克风和摄像头设为允许。具体名称取决于你的浏览器。
3. 回到直播课，再点一次**麦克风**或**摄像头**。
4. 如果仍被阻止，请在设备的隐私设置中允许浏览器使用摄像头和麦克风。如果提示“未找到摄像头或麦克风，或设备正被其他应用占用”，请关闭占用的应用后重试。

faqs.questionEn: The lesson list says Start, not Resume Learning. Did I lose my progress?
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: Which plan should I choose to get the full course?
faqs.answerEn:
1. On the course page, select **View all benefits**. This opens **Choose your plan**.
2. Pick a plan: **Everything** (all categories), **Category** (any one category of your choice), or a plan for this course only, such as **Epicureanism · PC · 6 months**. **6 Months** and **12 Months** switch the term.
3. Select the button on your plan (for example **Continue to purchase**, or **Get Everything** with its price), then complete checkout.
faqs.questionZh: 要学完整课程，应该选哪个方案？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 在课程页选择**查看所有权益**，会打开**选择订阅计划**。
2. 选择方案：**全部课程**（包含所有分类）、**分类课程**（任选一个分类），或只针对本课程的方案，例如 **Epicureanism · PC · 6 months**。**6 个月**和 **12 个月**用来切换订阅周期。
3. 点击所选方案上的按钮（例如**继续购买**，或带价格的“订阅全部课程”），然后完成付款。

faqs.questionEn: The course page says Video & text dual-mode learning, but my lesson only has text. Why?
faqs.answerEn:

1. A drop-down labelled **Video mode** or **Text mode** means the course offers both.
2. A plain **Text mode** label with no arrow means this course has text only.
3. If you expected a video, select your avatar at the top right, open **My Learning** and select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box at the bottom of the left menu (on a phone, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**).

faqs.answerEn: It counts the lesson tests that are available in the course. Each lesson that has them contributes a **Knowledge Test** and an **Application Test**, so two lessons make four. Each test you complete adds one.

faqs.questionEn: I can't see a View exhibit button. Where is it?
faqs.answerEn:
**View exhibit** shows on an **Exhibit Available** card, and only where the course has an exhibit for that part of the lesson. Not every lesson has one.
1. In a video lesson, the card pops up while the video plays, at the point the exhibit is meant to be seen.
2. In a text lesson, the card sits in the text between paragraphs.
3. To see a lesson's exhibits in one place, select **Explore further** in the **Deep Learning** panel, then open the **Exhibits** tab. This needs full access to the course.

faqs.questionEn: What is the difference between Lecture and Socratic?
faqs.answerEn:
**Lecture** explains the answer to you directly. **Socratic** guides you with questions and hints so you work it out yourself.

2. The new mode applies to your next question and your current chat stays. You cannot switch while the tutor is answering.

faqs.questionEn: I have a plan but the group still says Course access required.
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: How long will I wait for the Host to start?
faqs.answerEn:
The waiting window stays open until the Host starts the session or its planned end time passes (the start time plus the session's length). Keep the page open while you wait.
1. If the Host starts, the session opens for you.
2. If the planned end time passes and nobody has started it, the waiting window closes and the card says **Not started** and **This Live Session was not started.**
3. A session that was not started cannot be joined. Look for the group's next session, or ask the Host to schedule a new one.

faqs.questionEn: The start time has passed, but I still can't see Start Live Session.
faqs.answerEn:

faqs.questionEn: The time is later on my clock, but it still says it must be in the future.
faqs.answerEn:

1. Check that your device's date, time and time zone are correct.
2. Choose a **Date** and **Start Time** later than now, then select **Schedule Session**.

1. 检查设备的日期、时间和时区是否正确。
2. 把**日期**和**开始时间**选在现在之后，然后点击**安排本节**。

faqs.questionEn: How do I ask AI Tutor during the Live Session?
faqs.answerEn:
In the chat box, start your message with **@AI Tutor** or pick it from the mention list. The box reads **Type your message or @AI Tutor...**
1. The room answers questions one at a time, and you can have up to two waiting. If you see **Wait for the AI Tutor to answer your earlier questions first.**, wait for an answer and ask again.
2. To take back a question that is still waiting, select **Withdraw**.
AI Tutor only answers while the Live Session is live and AI Tutor is on for that session.

2. 想收回还在排队的问题，请点击**撤回**。

faqs.questionEn: What do Pay now, Term and Next payment mean on the confirmation page?
faqs.answerEn: **Pay now** is what you are charged today for the first term. **Term** is the length of that first term, with its start and end dates underneath. **Next payment** is the date of the next charge. The plan renews automatically unless you cancel.
faqs.questionZh: 确认订阅页面里的“本次支付”“时长”和“下次付款”是什么意思？
faqs.answerZh: **本次支付**是你今天为第一个周期支付的金额。**时长**是第一个周期的长度，下面会显示它的起止日期。**下次付款**是下一次扣款的日期。除非你取消，方案会自动续订。

faqs.questionEn: The Receipt column shows a dash instead of View receipt. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
View receipt only appears on a payment marked **Paid** that has a recorded payment. Free-trial activations (**Trial activation**), **Payment cancelled**, **Payment pending** and failed payments show a dash.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription**, select **Payment history** and check the **Status** of that row.
2. If the row says **Paid** and you still have no **View receipt**, contact support: select **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box, choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type** and say which payment you mean. Do not include card details.
