faqs.questionEn: What does Check payment status do, and how long should I wait?
faqs.answerEn:
It refreshes the page to see whether the payment has been confirmed. It only shows while a payment is still being confirmed, and that payment's row says **Payment pending**. The page also refreshes by itself every 2 seconds for about 30 seconds. The product does not give a longer set time.
1. Select **Check payment status**, or wait a little and refresh the page.
2. Return to **My Learning** > **My Subscription** later and look under **Current subscriptions**.
3. If a payment you completed is still not there, contact support through **Contact Support**, with **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type**.

1. 点击**重新查询支付状态**，或稍等片刻后刷新页面。
2. 稍后回到**我的学习** > **我的订阅**，在**当前订阅**下查看。
3. 如果你已完成的付款仍未出现，请通过**联系客服**联系我们，在**问题类型**中选择**支付与订阅**。

faqs.questionEn: If I cancel, do I get money back for the rest of my term?
faqs.answerEn:
No. Payments already made are non-refundable. Cancelling a paid plan stops the next renewal, and your access stays active until the date shown.
1. Open **My Learning** > **My Subscription** and select **Cancel auto-renewal** on the plan card.
2. Read the dialog. It says your access stays active until the date shown and that payments already made are non-refundable.
3. To keep renewing, select **Keep auto-renewal** instead.

1. 打开**我的学习** > **我的订阅**，在方案卡片上点击**取消自动续订**。
2. 阅读弹窗。它会说明你仍可使用到显示的日期，且已支付的费用不予退还。
3. 如果想继续续订，请选择**保留自动续费**。

faqs.questionEn: Does Learning Guide save my card? Can I remove it?
faqs.answerEn:
Learning Guide does not store your full card number or security code. There is no saved-card section in **My Subscription**, so you cannot remove a card there.
1. On **Confirm your subscription** you authorise Stripe to charge your payment method each new period until you cancel. Each period is as long as your plan: **6 Months** or **12 Months**. To stop future charges, select **Cancel auto-renewal** on the plan card.
2. For other questions about your card, I can't say what support can do, but you can ask through **Contact support** in the **Contact us** box. Do not include card details.

faqs.questionEn: If I reset my password, will the other device be signed out?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. When a password reset is finished, every sign-in that was active on your account ends, including the one on your own device, so you sign in again afterwards.
1. On the sign-in page, enter your **Email**, select **Continue**, then select **Forgot password?** and **Send reset email**.

faqs.questionEn: How do I stop the paid term from starting?

faqs.questionEn: Will clearing my browser cache sign me out?
faqs.answerEn:
If you clear only saved images and files, you usually stay signed in. If you also clear cookies or all site data, you will be signed out and need to sign in again. Your courses and subscription belong to your account, not to your browser.

faqs.questionEn: My video freezes even though my Wi-Fi looks fine. What can I try?
faqs.answerEn:
Try these steps:
1. Move closer to your Wi-Fi router, or use a wired connection if you have one.
2. Pause large downloads and videos on other tabs and devices.
3. Select **Camera** to switch your camera off while you listen, and close other apps or tabs that use your camera or microphone.
4. If it still freezes, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, choose **Technical Support**, and tell us the session time.

faqs.questionEn: How long does the page keep trying to reconnect?
faqs.answerEn:
It keeps trying by itself for as long as the page stays open, waiting a little longer each time, up to about 30 seconds between tries. It stops if the session has ended, is full, or your account no longer has access. You can select **Reconnect** at any time to try straight away.
1. Select **Reconnect**.
2. Check your network, switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data or turning off your VPN.
3. Select **Reconnect** again. If it still fails, select **Help Center / FAQ** in the page footer, then **Contact Support**, and choose **Technical Support**.

1. 点击**重新连接**。
2. 检查网络，在 Wi-Fi 和移动数据之间切换，或关闭 VPN。
3. 再点击一次**重新连接**。仍然失败，请点击页面底部的**帮助中心 / 常见问题**，再点击**联系客服**，选择**技术支持**。

faqs.questionEn: What is the Return to Course button for?
faqs.answerEn:
It takes you back to your course. You see it when a Live Session has ended (the page says **Thanks for studying together**), and also after you leave a session yourself. An ended session cannot be joined again.
1. Select **Return to Course**.
2. Carry on with the lessons in your course.
3. To study together again, check **Study Groups** for the next session. If you only left and the session is still live, select **Rejoin** instead.

3. 想再一起学习，请到**学习小组**里查看下一节直播课。如果你只是离开了、直播课仍在进行，请点击**重新加入**。

faqs.answerEn: No. The Live Session does not change your lesson progress. Lesson progress is saved from the lesson page, for example when you select **Next lesson**. You can check it on **My Learning**.

faqs.questionEn: If my phone goes to sleep, do I lose my place in the Live Session?
faqs.answerEn:
Not always. Your place is held while your page keeps checking in. If your phone sleeps for a while, the place can be given up, and you are put back in if there is still room.
1. Come back to the Live Session page. It checks your place again as soon as you return. Select **Reconnect** if it shows.
2. If every place has been taken meanwhile, the page says **Session full**. Select **Try again** once someone has left.
The page does not say how long your place is held.

2. 如果这期间座位已被占满，页面会显示**人数已满**，等有人离开后点击**重试**。

faqs.questionEn: Where do I turn on screen recording for my browser on a Mac?
faqs.answerEn:
1. On your Mac, open **System Settings**.
2. Select **Privacy & Security**, then **Screen Recording**. On newer versions it is called **Screen & System Audio Recording**.
3. Switch your browser on, quit the browser fully, and open it again.
4. Menu names can differ between macOS versions, so use the closest match if your screen looks different.

3. 把你的浏览器打开，然后完全退出浏览器，再重新打开。
4. 不同版本的 macOS 菜单名称可能略有不同，请选最接近的一项。

faqs.questionEn: How do I work out what time that is on my own clock?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Find the time zone your host used, for example New York.
2. Work out the difference between that city and yours. For example, Shanghai is 12 hours ahead of New York until the US clocks change on 1 November 2026, and 13 hours ahead after that.
3. Add or take away those hours, then check the date too, because the date can change.
faqs.questionZh: 那我该怎么把时间换算成自己这边的时间？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 先找出主持人使用的时区，例如纽约时间。
2. 算出两地的时差。比如上海比纽约快：在美国于 2026 年 11 月 1 日调整时钟之前是 12 小时，之后是 13 小时。
3. 加上或减去这些小时，并检查日期是否也变了。

faqs.questionEn: My host said Friday evening, but my card shows a different day. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
The date can change when the time zone changes, because the time can pass midnight. For example, 3:30 pm on Friday 30 October in New York is 3:30 am on Saturday 31 October in Shanghai.
1. Compare the date as well as the time.
2. Ask your host for the date and the time zone together.

faqs.answerZh:

1. 日期和时间都要对照。
2. 请主持人把日期和时区一起告诉你。

faqs.questionEn: What does 25:00 under a lesson mean? Is that 25 minutes?
faqs.answerEn: Yes. **25:00** is minutes and seconds, so that lesson is 25 minutes long. The total at the top of the course page is worked out from the lesson lengths.

faqs.questionEn: Do the tests count toward the lesson length?
faqs.answerEn: No. The lesson length is for the lesson itself, and the course total is worked out from those lengths only. **Knowledge Test** and **Application Test** are not part of it.
faqs.questionZh: 测试的时间算在课时时长里吗？
faqs.answerZh: 不算。课时时长只针对课时本身，课程总时长也只根据这些课时时长算出来。**知识测试**和**应用测试**不计入。

faqs.questionEn: What does Review Course do? Does it reset my progress?
faqs.answerEn: **Review Course** opens a lesson from the course so you can go back over the content. It does not reset your progress: the card keeps **Completed** and **100%**.

faqs.questionEn: If I go back to an earlier lesson, does the percentage go down?
faqs.answerEn: No. Going back to an earlier lesson does not lower the percentage. It only goes up once you get further than you have been before.
faqs.questionZh: 回看前面的课时，进度会往下掉吗？
faqs.answerZh: 不会。回看前面的课时不会让百分比下降，只有当你学到比之前更靠后的位置时，它才会上涨。

faqs.questionEn: Are Video Mode and Text Mode progress counted separately?
faqs.answerEn: Your place is remembered separately for each mode, so **Video Mode** and **Text Mode** can be at different lessons. The percentage on the card is the furthest you have got so far, and it does not go down when you switch modes.
faqs.questionZh: 视频模式和文本模式的进度是分开算的吗？
faqs.answerZh: 每种模式会分别记住你学到的位置，所以**视频模式**和**文本模式**可能停在不同的课时。卡片上的百分比是你目前学到的最远位置，切换模式不会让它下降。

faqs.questionEn: Can I do the Knowledge Test before I select Complete Course?
faqs.answerEn: Yes. The window lists **Knowledge Test** and **Application Test** (a test only shows if that lesson has one). Open one, and when you leave it you are back in the window to select **Complete Course**. You can also skip the tests.

faqs.answerEn: Yes. Your last lesson is saved before the window opens, so closing it with the X does not undo anything. Open **My Learning** and the card shows **Completed** and **100%**.

faqs.questionEn: I only have the three-day trial. Can I still create a Study Group?
faqs.answerEn:
Yes. A started trial gives you access to that course, so it shows under **Related Course** and you can create the group.
1. Open the course page, select **View all benefits** and choose a plan under **Choose a plan**.
2. Select **Start three-day trial**, tick the three **Required confirmations**, select **Continue** and complete checkout.
3. Go to **Study Groups**, select **+ Create Study Group**, pick the course under **Related Course** and select **Create Study Group**.
Only some courses offer a trial.

3. 进入**学习小组**，点击**+ 创建学习小组**，在**相关课程**中选择该课程，然后点击**创建学习小组**。

faqs.questionEn: I have a plan, but I can't create a Study Group for a course in another category. Why?
faqs.answerEn:
A plan only covers the courses it includes. A **Category** plan covers the courses in its own category, **Everything** covers every category, and a course-only plan covers just that course. A course outside your plan will not appear under **Related Course**.
1. Open the course page and check **INCLUDED WITH A CATEGORY PLAN**, or select **View all benefits**.
2. Get a plan that covers the course, then go back to **Study Groups**.
3. Select **+ Create Study Group** and choose the course under **Related Course**.

方案只覆盖它所包含的课程。**分类课程**方案覆盖所选分类里的课程，**全部课程**覆盖所有分类，仅限某门课的方案只覆盖那一门课。不在你方案内的课程不会出现在**相关课程**中。
1. 打开课程页面，查看**包含在分类订阅计划中**，或点击**查看所有权益**。
2. 获得覆盖这门课程的方案，然后回到**学习小组**。
3. 点击**+ 创建学习小组**，在**相关课程**中选择该课程。

faqs.questionEn: Why does the date in my reference number not match today's date?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The date part (for example 261029) is worked out in **UTC**, world time, not your local time.
2. So an enquiry sent in China between midnight and 8 am can show the day before your calendar date.
3. The number still identifies your enquiry, so keep it as it is.

2. 因此在中国时间凌晨 0 点到早上 8 点之间提交的工单，日期可能是前一天。
3. 工单号仍然对应你的这个工单，请保持原样。

faqs.answerEn: Yes. It stays in **My enquiries** with the status **Withdrawn**. Its page says **You withdrew this enquiry.** and has no reply box.

faqs.questionEn: What do I fill in when I send the same problem again?
faqs.answerEn:
1. Open **Contact Support** and choose an **Enquiry Type**.
2. Write the problem again in **Subject** and **Message**. If it helps, mention the old reference number in **Message**.
3. Attach files again if needed, then select **Submit Enquiry**.

2. 在**主题**和**详细描述**中重新写明问题。如果有帮助，可以在**详细描述**中写上旧的工单号。
3. 需要的话重新添加附件，然后点击**提交问题**。

faqs.questionEn: What do 'You might be asking' and 'Not what you need?' mean?
faqs.answerEn:
1. In the chat, **You might be asking:** lists questions close to yours. Select one to see its answer.
2. When you select **Submit Enquiry** and there is no exact answer, a window can show **You might be asking** with questions to pick from. Select one to read its answer there.
3. **Not what you need?** sits beside **None of these, submit to support**, which sends your enquiry to our support team. **Edit my enquiry** takes you back to the form.
faqs.questionZh: “你可能想问”和“都不是你要找的？”是什么意思？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 在聊天中，**你可能想问：**下面列出与你的问题接近的问题，选择一项即可看到解答。
2. 点击**提交问题**后，如果没有完全匹配的解答，窗口中可能会显示**你可能想问**，请选择一项，就能在窗口里看到解答。
3. **都不是你要找的？**旁边是**都不是，提交给客服**，点击后会把你的问题提交给客服团队。**修改我的问题**会带你回到表单。

faqs.questionEn: The assistant says I have asked too many questions. What now?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The assistant says: "You’ve asked a lot of questions in the last hour. Please try again later, or submit an enquiry using the form."
2. Wait a while, then ask again. The page does not say exactly how long.
3. If it is urgent, fill in the **Contact Support** form and select **Submit Enquiry** instead.
faqs.questionZh: AI 客服助手提示我一小时内提问太多，怎么办？

2. 稍等一会儿再提问，页面没有说明具体要等多久。
3. 如果比较紧急，请改为填写**联系客服**表单，然后点击**提交问题**。

faqs.questionEn: Is there a live chat with a real person?
faqs.answerEn: Not that I can see on the support pages. To reach our team, send an enquiry from **Contact Support**. The team replies by email, and you can follow the enquiry in **My enquiries**.

faqs.questionEn: Can the assistant change my plan or refund me?
faqs.answerEn: No. It only shows answers from our FAQs and says it cannot access your account, orders or payment records. For a plan or payment problem, select **Contact Support**, choose **Payments & Subscriptions** as the **Enquiry Type** and select **Submit Enquiry**.
faqs.questionZh: AI 客服助手能帮我改方案或退款吗？

faqs.questionEn: Does pressing No under Helpful? send my question to support?
faqs.answerEn: No. Under a chat answer, **No** only records that the answer did not help, and nothing is sent to support. To send your question, fill in the **Contact Support** form and select **Submit Enquiry**. If a window with an answer then appears, **No, still submit to support team** in that window does send it.

faqs.questionEn: After I vote, are the buttons still greyed out if I refresh?
faqs.answerEn: Yes, in the same tab. Your choice stays on that answer, so both buttons stay greyed out. A new tab or another device starts the chat again.

faqs.questionEn: I clicked the Related FAQ link but I cannot find the answer. What now?
faqs.answerEn:
1. The link opens the **Help Center** in a new tab with that question already expanded. Select the question to open or close its answer.
2. If the page says "This article is no longer available. Here are some other answers that may help.", that FAQ has been removed. Type your question in **Search help articles...** instead.
3. If you still cannot find it, send an enquiry from **Contact Support**.
faqs.questionZh: 点击“相关问题”后找不到答案，怎么办？
faqs.answerZh:
1. 链接会在新标签页中打开**帮助中心**，并展开对应的问题。点击问题可以展开或收起答案。
2. 如果页面显示“这篇文章已不再提供。以下是其他可能有帮助的解答。”，说明这个问题已被移除，请在**搜索帮助文章…**中输入你的问题。
3. 仍然找不到的话，请在**联系客服**中提交问题。

faqs.questionEn: The Related FAQ question is not exactly what I asked. Is the answer wrong?
faqs.answerEn: Not necessarily. The assistant does not write new answers. It shows the answer of the closest FAQ, and **Related FAQ** shows that FAQ's question. If it does not fit, select **No** under **Helpful?**, try asking in plainer words, or send an enquiry from **Contact Support**.

faqs.questionEn: How do I clear the chat or start a new one?
faqs.answerEn: The **AI Support Assistant** has no clear or new-chat button. To start again, open a new browser tab and go to **Contact Support**. The old tab keeps its chat.

faqs.questionEn: Will my chat still be there if I sign out and sign in again?
faqs.answerEn: Usually yes, if you stay in the same browser tab. Signing out does not clear the chat. It is kept in that tab for your account, so it comes back when you sign in to the same account there. Another account has its own chat, and a new tab or a closed tab starts a new one.
faqs.questionZh: 退出登录后再登录，聊天记录还在吗？
faqs.answerZh: 一般还在，前提是仍在同一个浏览器标签页中。退出登录不会清除聊天记录，聊天按你的账户保存在该标签页中，所以在这个标签页重新登录同一个账户后会再次出现。其他账户有各自的聊天记录，新开或关闭标签页后会重新开始。
